description: This file defines the DataSeries class within the PhpSpreadsheet chart namespace. It includes constants for chart types, groupings, and styles, as well as properties and methods for managing chart data series, such as plot type, grouping, direction, labels, categories, values, and styles. The class enables configuration and manipulation of chart data series in spreadsheets.

classes.name: DataSeries
classes.description: Represents a chart data series configuration within PhpSpreadsheet, allowing for setting types, grouping, direction, labels, categories, values, styles, and squeezing the chart data for rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new DataSeries object with optional plot type, grouping, order, labels, categories, values, direction, smoothing, and style.

methods.name: getPlotType
methods.description: Returns the plot type of the data series.

methods.name: setPlotType
methods.description: Sets the plot type of the data series.

methods.name: getPlotGrouping
methods.description: Returns the grouping configuration of the data series.

methods.name: setPlotGrouping
methods.description: Sets the grouping configuration of the data series.

methods.name: getPlotDirection
methods.description: Returns the direction of the plot.

methods.name: setPlotDirection
methods.description: Sets the direction of the plot.

methods.name: getPlotOrder
methods.description: Returns the order of the plots in the series.

methods.name: getPlotLabels
methods.description: Returns the array of plot label values.

methods.name: getPlotLabelByIndex
methods.description: Returns a specific plot label value by index.

methods.name: getPlotCategories
methods.description: Returns the array of plot category values.

methods.name: getPlotCategoryByIndex
methods.description: Returns a specific plot category value by index.

methods.name: getPlotStyle
methods.description: Returns the style of the plot.

methods.name: setPlotStyle
methods.description: Sets the plot style.

methods.name: getPlotValues
methods.description: Returns the array of plot values.

methods.name: getPlotValuesByIndex
methods.description: Returns plot values at a specified index.

methods.name: getPlotBubbleSizes
methods.description: Returns the array of bubble sizes for bubble charts.

methods.name: setPlotBubbleSizes
methods.description: Sets the bubble sizes for bubble charts.

methods.name: getPlotSeriesCount
methods.description: Returns the number of data series in plot values.

methods.name: getSmoothLine
methods.description: Returns whether the line is smoothed.

methods.name: setSmoothLine
methods.description: Sets whether the line should be smoothed.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes data references against the provided worksheet.
